jobs.subject: One simple calendar with two broad binding tabs and one large highlighted circular date.
jobs.colors: deep red #9F0712, pale reds #FFE2E2 and #FFC9C9, one small amber #FEE685 date
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a small decorative editorial illustration for a university Slidev card, replacing an overly detailed background picture.
Subject: a single calendar seen straight on, slightly turned only in silhouette, with two broad binding tabs and ONE large circular highlighted date; no tiny grid of numbers. Maximum 5 or 6 deliberately drawn broad shapes.
Style: exceptionally simple stylized flat cut-paper illustration, crisp smooth silhouettes, bold quiet geometry, solid matte color fills, no outline strokes, no people, no scene, no realism or 3D, no shadows, no texture, no gradients, no lettering or numbers. This is a modern editorial spot illustration, not a detailed UI or screenshot.
Palette: deep red #9F0712, pale red #FFC9C9 and #FFE2E2, with one small amber #FEE685 accent; all opaque subject fills, actual transparent alpha background. Do not substitute black or gray.
Composition: one compact square motif filling about 85% of the transparent square canvas, readable at 130 pixels. The real UI will clip a small portion of its right and bottom edges inside the lower-right corner of a card. Keep the central sign recognizable with that crop; keep silhouette broad and spare. No surrounding frame, badge, circular background, cloud or ornament.
Constraints: only the calendar motif, no text, letters, numerals, watermark, additional objects, people, hands or desk. Genuine transparent background, not a checkerboard baked into the pixels.
